repository_intelligence.purpose: JavaScript Base44-shaped Supabase compatibility adapter for entity CRUD and user/auth operations with migration guidance; email, upload, image and extraction integrations include mocks rather than real services.
repository_intelligence.reuse_recommendation: Use as a migration reference or extract narrowly reviewed CRUD; do not deploy its current privileged-client/auth path in a browser.
repository_intelligence.inspection_scope: Bounded pinned README/manifest/tree and relevant source review; deeper components, security and runtime verification are demand-driven. Detailed asset records remain unchanged.
repository_intelligence.license_notes: MIT source; Supabase service/data permissions are separate.
risk_notes: Service-role access is constructed from a VITE-prefixed variable and selected automatically for some entities: never bundle a real service key in a browser. Import-time queries, development-login behavior and user/session logging need isolation/removal. Mock success does not prove delivery or processing; universal API compatibility is unverified.
